title: Bowling Green Golf Club
specs: Classic woodlands golf course designed by Geoffrey Cornish
Dynamic pricing for tee times based on demand, season, weather, and events
Flexible cancellation and rain check policies for weather
Golf simulator with technology behind TGL (Tiger & Rory’s indoor golf simulator league)
Players must be 21 years old to rent a riding cart
Children under 16 must be accompanied and supervised by an adult in simulator
Proper attire required; soft spikes only

blurb: Guests play golf on a classic woodlands layout designed by Geoffrey Cornish with a variety of pricing options including dynamic pricing for tee times. Lessons and clinics are available focusing on fundamentals and course management. The club offers season passes with various access levels and a golf simulator for practice and play.
